I put Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 through seven real workflows, from websites and motion design to spreadsheets, action plans, and live dashboards.

In my opinion, using Sonnet generally doesn’t make much sense for me when it comes to coding. Opus 5.5 Medium has an Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index of 51 and a cost per task of $1.34. Sonnet 5.5 xhigh has an index of 52 and a cost of approximately $2.74. It’s much more expensive for nearly the same level of intelligence per task. Sonnet 5.5 High has an index of 47 and a cost of $1.08 per task. I’d rather use Opus 5.5 Medium as my default and pay a little more for greater intelligence. Speed might be a factor, though. It makes more sense to use MiMo-V2.6-Pro, which offers significantly lower costs while delivering nearly the same performance as Sonnet 5.5 High.
